neighbours.label: the words contest / contestant / pageant (a judged contest), as against other words for a competition (competition, tournament, race, match)
fire: Every summer the library runs a short story contest for teenagers.

Several contestants forgot their lines during the live broadcast.
Her mother entered her in local pageants when she was six.
The county fair ends with a pie-baking contest in the main tent.
Two of the contestants were disqualified for using notes.
The town's harvest pageant draws visitors from three states.
Our office held a costume contest on the last Friday of October.
